pr.body:
## Finding and owner
PAPERS-01, orchestrator#81. Existing Hub executor owns the typed runsc policy; no RemoteOps mutation or new supervisor/schema. Current main dbad915ccf0431b61b4f60ef16b1fc4e2cbc72b4; exact candidate 25f598fd73de99759fb801c21c6845a652f71cb0. #87/#88/#14 already merged and qualified; not refusionned or recounted.

## Correction
Pair host pids-limit with guest soft/hard RLIMIT_NPROC using the requested PID budget. Restrict budgets to1..4096. Reject root-owned workspace before container creation so UID0 cannot silently bypass the guest process-count policy. Preserve CPU/RAM/swap/file/output/time/exact-ID cleanup and wire v1. Compatibility restriction: root-owned workspaces now fail closed; callers must use nonroot executor-owned directories.

## Real bounded qualification
Fixed Rust source compiled only inside runsc. Eight sleeping children plus at most96 threads; no exponential fork, production or host execution. Require nonroot UID, exact guest soft/hard limits64, real entry, eight child processes, positive thread creation and EAGAIN below64 total child tasks. Independent128 control must create all104 child tasks, then join threads/kill+reap children. Exact-ID cleanup still mandatory; no receipt accepted for unresolved cleanup. Existing five controls rerun on this HEAD. Fixture argv/root/budget tests are protocol admission tests, not OS/hardware evidence.

## Validation/gates
Local diff check and Python syntax passed; rustfmt/cargo unavailable locally, no host fallback. Full exact-head fmt/clippy/build/test/doc and real runsc gates plus review must succeed, then guarded merge and integrated gates/artifact. No old green reused; if the runtime ignores a limit the real gate must fail, not weaken predicates. Required off-main Hub/ML/AX/orchestrator policies and current code read; unchanged historic grants/attributions.

## Remaining
Aggregate workspace quota and durable quarantine/ambiguous creation reconciliation remain incomplete; original PAPERS-01 not closed on this slice. PAPERS consumer must repin only after exact owner integrated qualification. No empirical promotion or performance/maturity claim. Source runtime model: https://gvisor.dev/docs/architecture_guide/resources/ (host and guest tasks need not correspond).

## Corrected independent qualification / root fixtures
Final candidate b57ea18ece394189885d891fb4b88c33c1167bea. Optional stricter guest_pids_limit preserves omitted legacy JSON; host limit stays512 for both finite max105-task probes, guest64 then128. Root-owned real workspaces refused before Docker creation. Fake-Docker tests reassign only their newly owned leaf under UID0; CI executes exact compiled protocol test binary as root under a bounded clean environment, not sandbox evidence. Two initial review findings resolved with linked correction; earlier coupled-control green25f not reused. Intermediate3bb failed compile due chown namespace and is superseded. Exact new candidate and integrated gates/artifacts/review required; no quota/quarantine closure claim.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Isolate the guest limit from the host PID limit**

In the qualification workflow, both observations pass `budget` through `pids_limit`, which makes `gvisor.rs` set both Docker `--pids-limit` and guest `--ulimit nproc` to the same value. Consequently, EAGAIN at 64 can be caused entirely by the container PID control while `/proc/self/limits` only proves that RLIMIT_NPROC was configured, not enforced; raising both controls to 128 does not disambiguate them. Docker documents these as separate controls ([`--pids-limit`](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/container/create/) and [`--ulimit nproc`](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/container/run/#for-nproc-usage)). Keep the host limit above the probe range, or otherwise vary the controls independently, before accepting this as guest-limit qualification.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L42-L42](https://github.com/Memorithm/scirust-hub/blob/25f598fd73de99759fb801c21c6845a652f71cb0/AGENTS.md#L42-L42)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Corrected at 3bb8a7ab97c06db5670218b620eed13cf37c3681: guest_pids_limit is an optional stricter ceiling (1..host budget), preserving legacy JSON omission and refusing implicit host-budget widening. Both finite real probes now hold host --pids-limit at 512 while changing only guest RLIMIT_NPROC 64→128; at most 105 guest tasks are attempted. The new candidate gates must rerun, and the earlier coupled receipts are not claimed as independent guest enforcement.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep root-run unit tests on nonroot fixture paths**

When `cargo test` runs as UID 0, as it commonly does in development containers, `temporary()` creates root-owned workspaces and this new check rejects every success-path fixture before the fake Docker command runs. In particular, `exact_docker_controls_and_receipt_are_typed` now panics at `unwrap()`, while cleanup tests receive the workspace-owner error instead of exercising cleanup. Construct or chown those fixture workspaces to a nonroot UID when the test process is root.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Corrected at 3bb8a7ab97c06db5670218b620eed13cf37c3681: the five fake-Docker fixture tests create a fresh owned task directory and, only under UID 0, reassign that directory to UID/GID 1001. Production root-owned workspaces still fail closed. CI now additionally runs the exact compiled gvisor::tests binary under UID 0, with cleared environment and a 30-second deadline; this validates protocol fixtures only, not sandbox qualification. Checkout credentials are not persisted.
